hook: Morgan Stanley brings crypto to E*Trade

stories.text: Morgan Stanley launches BTC, ETH, SOL on E*Trade
stories.summary: Morgan Stanley enabled eligible E*Trade customers to buy, sell, and hold Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Solana via Zero Hash, marking a major institutional push.

stories.text: Ostium perp DEX loses $18 million in oracle attack
stories.summary: Attackers compromised an oracle signer key on Arbitrum-based Ostium, draining roughly $18 million from the perpetuals exchange.

stories.text: Galaxy Digital opens $100M on-chain lending for institutions
stories.summary: Galaxy Digital is backing a managed on-chain lending program with $100 million from its balance sheet to offer institutional crypto borrowing.

stories.text: BitPay secures EU crypto license under MiCA
stories.summary: Cryptocurrency payment processor BitPay received authorization to operate across the European Union under the bloc's MiCA regulation.

stories.text: Senators to brief Trump on crypto regulation bill Thursday
stories.summary: Senators plan to meet with President Trump on Thursday to update him on negotiations around a landmark crypto regulation bill.
